children: Gold prices stabilized on Tuesday, September 15, with the international ounce hitting $4,287.6 for buying and $4,287 for selling.
The 24-karat price recorded EGP 7,169.67 for purchase and EGP 7,083.98 for sale, according to Dahab Masr data at 3:58 PM.
Meanwhile, the 21-karat gold hit EGP 6,274.09 for buying and EGP 6,199.1 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt stable on September 15
